description: Blargg pal_apu_tests 01-03 (the three wired in cores/nes/tests/test_config.json). The 2005 sources target blargg's custom devcart assembler and runtime (runtime_rom_common.a even includes a ppu_util.a upstream never shipped in this directory), so the build translates the upstream test + support files to asm6f with tests/roms-src/include/runtime2005/to_asm6f.sed and links them against Veloce's runtime2005 (validation.a replacement reporting the $F8 result over the $401E VELOCE-RESULT/1 port; veloce_rom2005*.a ROM wrapper) (NES-3).
license: blargg (Shay Green) 2005 test code; upstream pal_apu_tests/readme.txt carries no licence statement (plan section 8 treats blargg's NES test ROMs as freely usable). Nothing from upstream is committed: sources are fetched at the pinned SHA and translated at build time.
golden_gate_reason: Upstream's binaries were built by blargg's own 2005 devcart assembler with a runtime (console.a/debug.a/ppu_util.a, on-screen text + beeps) that this build deliberately replaces, and one of its files (ppu_util.a) is not in the directory at the pinned SHA; no byte-identical rebuild is possible. Verified behaviourally instead; see PROVENANCE.md.

commands: for f in 01.len_ctr 02.len_table 03.irq_flag prefix_apu sync_apu delays; do sed -E -f /veloce-include/runtime2005/to_asm6f.sed $f.a > vbuild/$f.a || exit 1; done

for t in 01.len_ctr 02.len_table 03.irq_flag; do printf 'VELOCE_SUITE EQU "pal_apu_tests.%s"
INCLUDE "veloce_rom2005.a"
INCLUDE "%s.a"
INCLUDE "delays.a"
INCLUDE "veloce_rom2005_end.a"
' $t $t > veloce_$t.asm && asm6f -q veloce_$t.asm ../../$t.nes || exit 1; done
